title: Brooke Reports
description: A cozy field guide to persuasion literacy, marketing psychology, attention traps, and clear thinking — helping you spot pressure, hype, vague claims, and emotional framing before they shape your decisions.

author.name: Brookie
author.bio: Brookie writes Brooke Reports — field notes on thinking clearly in a world designed to make you react. Persuasion literacy, minus the gurus.
